## Background

## Catlab Set-Up

```{julia}
import Catlab.CategoricalAlgebra:
  @acset,
  @acset_type,
  @acset_colim,
  @present,
  FreeSchema,
  elements,
  nparts,
  representable,
  set_subpart!,
  src,
  subobject_classifier,
  tgt,
  yoneda
```

We now examine a degenerate spatial grid, with one node in the middle

```{julia}
@present gridCenterCardinalDirections(FreeSchema) begin
  (N,S,E,W)::Ob  # top cell

  cell::Ob

  N2Cell::Hom(N,cell)
  S2Cell::Hom(S,cell)
  E2Cell::Hom(E,cell)
  W2Cell::Hom(W,cell)
end;
```

```{julia}
@acset_type gridCenterCardinalDirectionsInstance(gridCenterCardinalDirections)
```

```{julia}
ΩgridCenterGardinalDirections,dictΩZZ4TP  = subobject_classifier(gridCenterCardinalDirectionsInstance)
```

```{julia}
@present grid3x3(FreeSchema) begin
  (c00,c01,c02)::Ob  # top row of cells
  (c10,c11,c12)::Ob  # left in middle row, middle cell, right cell in middle row
  (c20,c21,c22)::Ob  # bottom row of cells

  # wire up to central cell
  c01_to_c11::Hom(c01,c11)
  c10_to_c11::Hom(c10,c11)
  c12_to_c11::Hom(c12,c11)
  c21_to_c11::Hom(c21,c11)
end;
```
